scope: Public market-price provider interfaces and dated market-identity discovery leads; no stored quotes, balances or permanent preferred-pool routing

records.review_depth: Published pairs API, identity and price-field schema, and public HTTP request requirements
records.claim_stage: provider interface documentation, not verified chain state or executable trade pricing
locators: pairs[].chainId, pairAddress, dexId, labels, baseToken, quoteToken
records.summary: At review, the publisher-listed ETH/STANDARD pool on Robinhood used priceUsd for USD per STANDARD and priceNative for ETH per STANDARD. Re-establish exact pool and asset identities before using current quotes; this dated record is not a current pool binding.
limits: Provider-reported indicative prices, not block-scoped contract state or executable quotes.
The consumed API schema supplies no price-observation timestamp. HTTP retrieval, pool creation and image cache timestamps are not quote-observation times.
USD conversion is provider-reported; it is not independently verified ETH/USD feed data.
Gross quantity valuations exclude withdrawal fees, trading taxes, LP fees, slippage and gas. They are not charter resale values or guaranteed proceeds.
Requested historical reuse or caches must retain source and as-of context. Neither a saved price nor a fresh indicative quote establishes a future price.

records.review_depth: Public v2 pool API, version header, identity relationships and price-field schema
records.claim_stage: provider interface documentation, not verified chain state or executable trade pricing
locators: data.id, type, attributes.address and relationships.base_token, quote_token, dex
records.summary: The reviewed GeckoTerminal interface reports pool/token identities and USD/native prices together. For the reviewed ETH/STANDARD pool, the zero address identified native ETH, not a WETH display label. Authenticate current pool/asset relationships and retain denominations from one response.
limits: Public beta API; pin the declared version and retain provider attribution.
No quote-observation timestamp in the consumed pool interface. Retrieval, cache age, pool creation, candle and trade timestamps must not be relabelled as the pool quote's observation time.
More decimal digits do not establish greater accuracy; separate provider reads are not atomic or interchangeable.
Requested cross-checks report disagreement without averaging prices or mixing denominations. Derived models must identify their inputs and method.
CoinGecko onchain data belongs to the same provider family, not an independent third corroborating source.
Provider selection and requested historical reuse remain subject to host/provider access rules; never bypass an access restriction or label an old quote as current.

records.publisher: DEX Screener and GeckoTerminal provider-reported market identities
records.review_depth: Retrieved the token-pairs response and matching GeckoTerminal pool response; checked chain, v4 pool identifier, base/quote token identities and liquidity fields. No market prices retained as defaults.
records.claim_stage: dated provider market binding and discovery lead, not onchain pool verification or executable pricing

binding.quote_asset: native ETH; GeckoTerminal display name says WETH but relationship uses zero address
binding.limits: The 32-byte provider pool identifier is not a 20-byte ERC20 or PoolManager contract address. Refresh identity before applying a quote.

locators: DEX Screener token response: chainId, pairAddress, baseToken.address, quoteToken.address, priceUsd, liquidity.usd.
GeckoTerminal pool response: data.id, attributes.address, relationships.base_token/quote_token/dex, base_token_price_usd, reserve_in_usd.
records.summary: Both responses identified the same STANDARD/native-ETH v4 market and reported substantial liquidity. Use it as a first discovery candidate for routine STANDARD marks, subject to current identity and liquidity checks; never as a stored quote or mandatory target.
limits: The token response returned one pool in this retrieval; it is not an exhaustive all-market census or proof of permanently greatest liquidity.
No USDG pool binding was authenticated by this review. A thin USDG market, if discovered, is a separately assessed cross-check, not a $1 STANDARD peg.

Provider USD/native fields and liquidity estimates differed. Use the selected provider's explicit USD-per-STANDARD field, retain attribution/time, and report disagreement rather than silently average or combine conversion legs.
No quote-observation timestamp was established. Retrieval time is not price time; current marks applied to historical book amounts must be labelled as such.
Indicative gross market marks exclude fees, taxes, slippage and gas and do not establish funding eligibility or guaranteed proceeds.
